snippet.title: GRIDbeat! - Indie Fan Fest Release Date Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
It was an absolute pleasure to hack our way into Indie Fan Fest with GRIDbeat! 

Learn what it takes hack Knoss in this short overview trailer of the game!

GRIDbeat! is available March 26th, 2026!
Wishlist GRIDbeat! here 👉🏻 https://bit.ly/GRIDbeatYT
Check out the demo here 👉🏻 https://bit.ly/GRIDbeat_Demo

#acclaim #rhythmgame #indiegames
